notablePrerequisites: Rootwire Amalgam has a power of seven or greater.
description:
Activate Rootwire Amalgam by paying {3}{G}{G} and sacrificing it, creating a 21/21 (or larger) Golem artifact creature token.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain ten life and win the game.
